title: schema
summary: Prints the live schema of an index database: schemaversion, every table and column, and row counts

surfaces.usage: drag-lint schema --db <file.sqlite> [--format text|json] [--output <file>] (self-documenting LIVE index schema: schema_version + tables + columns + row counts, read-only)
help: drag-lint schema --db <file.sqlite> [--format text|json] [--output <file>]   (self-documenting LIVE index schema: schema_version + tables + columns + row counts, read-only)

drag-lint query --name-like <substring> [--kind class,interface,...] [--limit N] [--json] --db <file.sqlite>   (SUBSTRING search over symbol NAMES -- the discovery query, for when you do not know the identifier yet; ordered shortest-name-first. Distinct from --name, which is exact with an edit-distance fallback)
